name: sri-vasavi-agencies
description: Sri Vasavi Agencies - public website and GST billing ERP

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=backend & npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.db:create: docker run --rm --network host mysql:8 mysql -h 127.0.0.1 -P 4100 -u root -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS sva_erp CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci;"
